scenario_description:
Objective: Keep LM-4627's discharge-instruction audio pickup able to include spoken provider and clinic names in tomorrow's narrator prep.
Emerging Need: The vendor handoff shell is open with translated strings loaded, but the approved pronunciation-guide attachment needed for those names is absent.
Decision Context: The first notice is only a conditional audio placeholder; later scope, shell, and preflight records establish the missing prerequisite, cutoff, and still-editable packet. The authorized guide source is only in shared contact records.
Consequence: If the guide is not pursued before snapshot, the audio pickup can proceed but must omit those named audio cards.

parameter.title: LM-4627 discharge audio pickup planning hold
parameter.description: Conditional hold for narrator-prep coordination if Cascadia confirms the discharge-instruction audio pilot; no vendor handoff packet is open yet.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 discharge audio pilot confirmed for tomorrow
parameter.body: Cascadia confirmed the discharge-instruction audio pilot for tomorrow's narrator prep. The audio packet may include provider and clinic-name callouts, and the vendor prep rules say those names must use approved pronunciation-guide entries rather than phonetic guesses. We are still waiting to see whether the handoff extract carries the guide attachment.

parameter.content: I opened the LM-4627 audio handoff shell. The translated discharge strings loaded, but the pronunciation-guide attachment field is empty. The packet builder stays editable until 13:20 before it snapshots for tomorrow's narrator prep, so this is not blocking the shell build yet.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 audio packet preflight: pronunciation guide missing
parameter.body: Preflight check for LM-4627 discharge audio: translated strings are present; Provider/clinic pronunciation guide is missing. The packet remains editable until the 13:20 Pacific snapshot. Narrator preparation has not started, and named audio cards without approved entries will be excluded at snapshot.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 audio packet snapshot complete
parameter.body: The 13:20 Pacific snapshot completed for the LM-4627 discharge audio packet with no pronunciation-guide attachment. Tomorrow's narrator-prep packet has been generated without provider and clinic-name audio cards; late pronunciation files cannot be inserted into that 09:30 prep packet.
